slug: 2025-09-02 Egyptian court judgment tightens data-protection enforcement (Orange Egypt)

facts.fact: Shehata & Partners says the PDPL's executive regulations were still pending when the Economic Court of Alexandria ruled in February 2025.
facts.system: Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020

note: The EGP 10m Orange Egypt judgment (Feb 2025) rests on tort law and Cybercrime Law 175/2018, not on a decision under the PDPL, so it gives no application fact.
